system.description: Pick one of these instead of the usual Blood Quickening options. Metal: +1 Willpower and +1 Resilience; spend 1 Breath for Armor equal to Aspect until your next turn; claws get Power Field and +4 Pen. Void: +1 Composure; no need to breathe, surviving vacuum without a void suit; claws drain all of the victim's Hero Points and block their hit point recovery for one round. Heart: +1 Fellowship; spend 1 Breath to count one die of a social attack or social skill roll as a 10; claws gain Volatile and Orgone Array.
